milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the brown glazed terracotta block and face it to demonstrate they have located it. The target is a 2-block-tall pillar at spawn-relative position (3, 0, 2). max_distance=5 requires the agent to actually approach the block rather than trivially passing from spawn (which is ~3.6 blocks away, meaning the agent must at minimum face the correct direction and not drift away). facing_tolerance=45 ensures the agent is looking directly at the brown glazed terracotta rather than a nearby distractor block (brown terracotta at (-3,0,-2), brown concrete at (1,0,6), or plain terracotta at (6,0,3)).
